voice.instructions: Warm, upbeat and natural, like a friend showing you something cool. Short pauses between sentences.

scenes.say: Your training week, at a glance. Done, missed, or coming up.
Open Train, where programs and exercises live.
Browse over a thousand exercises, with filters for muscle and equipment.
Tap one, and the photos animate to show you the movement.
Close it, and you're right where you left off.

outro.title: LifePilot
outro.subtitle: Your personal trainer, in your pocket.
